description: Use when a user has order data (seller, buyer and items; prices, cartons and weights if known) and wants a proforma invoice, commercial invoice, packing list or shipping instruction; open_document also opens a purchase order, sales contract or certificate of origin, and open_form one of the extra forms. Create a matching proforma invoice, commercial invoice, packing list and shipping instruction from one set of order data. Returns a link to Triplicate's free generator with everything filled in (the user reviews it and saves the PDF), plus totals (amount, cartons, net/gross weight, CBM) and checks (missing fields, HS code format, Incoterms freight/insurance consistency). Nothing is stored.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the importing country (optional; otherwise taken from the port of discharge): adds that country's invoice rules to the checks

hs_totals.description: Also print totals by HS code (quantity, value, cartons, weights) on the invoice and packing list, for the customs broker's entry lines

imperial_units.description: Also show weights in pounds and volume in cubic feet on the packing list and shipping instruction (for US buyers)

country_of_origin.description: Only if this item's origin differs from shipment.country_of_origin; the documents then show the origin per item

free_of_charge.description: Sent free (samples, gifts): the value stays on the documents for customs and is taken off the amount payable

gtin.description: GTIN / EAN / UPC barcode number, if the product has one

not_originating.description: With origin_statement: this item does not qualify and is marked as not covered by the statement

packed_with_previous.description: Assorted cartons: packed in the same cartons as the item before it, whose carton weights include this item; leave its carton fields empty

section_232_metal_origin.description: US shipments of steel or aluminium articles: the countries where the steel was melted and poured or the aluminium smelted and cast, e.g. 'STEEL MELT AND POUR: KR'; printed under the description

sku.description: Seller's product code, printed under the description (EU import declarations for distance sales need it from 1 November 2026)

language.description: Language of the generator page the link opens (documents are in English)

letter_of_credit.description: Terms of the letter of credit (from MT700: 20, 31C, 32B, 39A, 44C, 31D, 48, 43P, 45A); the generator checks the documents against them (not among the free features)

show_on_documents.description: Print the L/C number and date on the documents

manufacturer.description: Who made the goods, printed on the commercial invoice with its MID code (US shipments: carriers and CBP ask for it; textile and apparel entries must show it). The generator suggests the MID from 19 CFR Part 102 if mid is empty

street.description: Street address line with the building number

notify.description: Notify party, if different from the buyer

open_document.description: pi proforma invoice, ci commercial invoice, pl packing list, si shipping instruction, sc sales contract (seller and buyer sign; the remarks become its other terms), co certificate of origin (non-preferential: the exporter's declaration, with space for a chamber of commerce to certify it), po purchase order (the buyer's order to the supplier: buyer = issuer, seller = supplier)

open_form.description: Also open one of the generator's extra forms with this data: VGM declaration (SOLAS, needs shipment.containers), ISF (10+2) data for a US buyer, USMCA/CUSMA certification of origin, packing declaration for sea containers to Australia, draft (bill of exchange), beneficiary's certificate, credit/debit note, shipping advice e-mail, or a return/repair invoice made from this invoice (the original invoice number, date and waybill as reference; the buyer as shipper when goods come back). Each has 3 free uses (the shipping advice has no limit).

origin_statement.description: Preferential origin statement printed on the commercial invoice in the agreement's exact wording (3 free uses). Only for goods that meet the agreement's rules of origin.

number.description: Approved exporter's authorisation number (EU-Korea, UK-Korea, EU-Vietnam; may be empty up to EUR 6,000 per consignment), REX number (EU GSP, EU-Canada, EU-Singapore; EU exporters), UEN (Singapore exporters, EU-Singapore), Exporter Reference No. (EU-Japan, UK-Japan, EU-UK: REX or GB EORI), Business Number (Canadian exporters) or customs identification number (UK DCTS)

origin.description: Origin as written in the statement, e.g. Korea, EU, Japan, European Union

origin_criterion.description: EU-Japan and UK-Japan: A, B, C1-C4, D or E. EU GSP and UK DCTS: P, or W followed by the HS heading (e.g. W 9618). Not used by the other agreements

period_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD; EU-Japan, UK-Japan, EU-UK, CETA: one statement for several shipments of identical products (12 months at most)

place.description: Place printed with the date, e.g. Seoul (default: the port of loading's city)

remarks.description: Optional remarks printed on the documents, e.g. 'SAMPLES OF NO COMMERCIAL VALUE, NOT FOR RESALE. VALUE FOR CUSTOMS PURPOSES ONLY.'

containers.description: Sea containers (FCL): printed as CONTAINER / SEAL NO. on the invoice, packing list and shipping instruction; the numbers are checked against their ISO 6346 check digit. In the generator, More > VGM declaration (3 free uses) makes the SOLAS VGM form from them

carton_numbers.description: Cartons in this container, e.g. '1-500': the packing list then shows each container's cartons, weights and CBM

duties_paid_by.description: Courier invoices: who pays the import duties and taxes (DDP: sender)

export_declaration_number.description: Export declaration, shipping bill or AES ITN number, printed in the remarks box

original_invoice_number.description: Goods going back (reason_for_export repair_and_return, returned_goods or temporary_export): the original shipment's invoice number, printed as ORIGINAL SHIPMENT

original_waybill_number.description: The original shipment's AWB or B/L number

pallets.description: If the cartons are palletized: the documents then show e.g. 4 PLTS (101 CTNS), gross weight with the empty pallets and the loaded pallets' volume

waybill_number.description: Air waybill or courier tracking number, printed in box 6

shipping_marks.description: Optional; generated from buyer, destination and carton count if empty

sold_to.description: Only if the buyer (sold to) is a different company from the consignee in 'buyer', e.g. a trading company buying for a factory: printed as BUYER (SOLD TO) on the invoice, the buyer on the proforma and sales contract

place.description: Named place, e.g. 'Busan' for FOB Busan
